scene: The turned dial drains the water, revealing three humming transport gates below.
picture: A flat side view along the tiled floor of a drained subway basin. On the far left sits an open industrial freight lift. In the centre, a glowing yellow night tram rests on newly exposed tracks. To the right stands the teenage boy looking at a tall glass service elevator on the far right.
shown: an open metal cage freight lift on the far left with gears humming
a glowing yellow night tram parked on rails at the centre
a tall glass service elevator with an open sliding door on the right
